# 3 Rotary position embedding

For a two-dimensional subspace, RoPE applies R(m theta) to the query at position m and R(n theta) to the key at position n. R(phi) = [[cos(phi), -sin(phi)], [sin(phi), cos(phi)]]. In higher dimensions, independent two-dimensional subspaces use frequencies theta_i. Adjacent real coordinates correspond to each complex component.
